evaluation_summary.root_cause_analysis: Multi-stage pipeline parsing breakdown across table segmentation and regex binding.

missed_rules_pipeline_autopsy.failure_mechanism: Two-column key-value summary table (| Total | $85.00 |) was parsed with $85.00 treated as column key header, generating spurious slug predicate 'has_85_00' rather than identifying subtotal semantic role.
Row 'Total Due | $93.50' in header metadata table experienced cell bleed across merged columns, resulting in claim subject bound to email 'admin@slicedinvoices.com' and predicate 'has_12345'.
Middle tax row (| Tax | $8.50 |) inherited the $85.00 column slug header, emitting 'Tax has_85_00 $8.50' instead of 'has_tax_amount'.

missed_rules_pipeline_autopsy.gold_object: due within 30 days from date of invoice
missed_rules_pipeline_autopsy.failure_mechanism: Invoice footer clause 'Payment is due within 30 days from date of invoice' was concatenated with preceding line item text and captured by default e-commerce return window regex as 'has_return_window' under subject 'Web Design $85'.
Late payment sentence 'Late payment is subject to fees of 5% per month' was concatenated to line item 'Web Design $85', causing Knockout 4 subject discrepancy and quarantining in raw discovery.

repair_strategy: Implement dedicated invoice parser plugin with layout-aware key-value total table recognizer and footer payment terms segmentation.
